capabilities: Show note text previews as cards
Open notes in a side peek panel
extras: Sends no data and needs no account; the only network use is loading cover images from web links (turn off Show cover image to avoid). Works on mobile except dragging cards between board columns; dragging edits notes.
problem: Obsidian's Bases views show properties but not note text previews, side peek panels, or inline comments like Notion.

relations.evidence: Slash Commander can put these commands in the / menu

summary: Notion-style gallery and board views for Bases that show note text previews, side peek panels, and inline comments.
